page.overview:
Who is Asian Gang Member?

The Asian Gang Member is a member of the Springfield Mafia. He is in the process of insulting and possibly shooting Krusty the Clown at Moe's Tavern, which is put to a halt when Moe closes the tavern when he joins the navy.
